title: 1815 Prairie rebuilt to its 1908 Daily News photograph
items: The Sears-Meeker house now shows the front Arthur Heun's 1902 remodel gave it, read off a 1908 Chicago Daily News photograph: a one-storey stone bay across the front with an iron balcony rail, an arched entrance at street level in a small stone block, and a tall iron railing along the walk.
The old stoop, pedimented door and corner bay, which the earlier undated photographs show, are gone for 1904; the upper storeys, attic and mansard are unchanged and match all three pictures.
Records now say why 1904 shows the remodel: Heun's work is dated 1902, and the 1908 photograph is the only picture after the sale.
